short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.
progress_note: G7 Semantic Field Fabric is ACCEPTED with full Windows aggregate PASS at tested head a75a60b6da739cc759e1fb40510a98942bce4cde. G8.0 starts from accepted metadata head d9a900c28dee3914bcaa4d6f6bde126aef56a77e. Initial contracts define a deterministic geomorphology profile and signed deformation sample with five components: valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition. Valley and river components may only lower the surface; other shaping components are signed. The sample binds body/frame/body-fixed position, profile checksum and source semantic bundle checksum; it contains no SurfaceCellKey, LOD, authority, interest, Matter, material, persistence or network identity. Focused validation is required before G8.1 valley formulas begin.
next_stage: Run G8.0 focused contracts. If green, accept G8.0 and proceed to G8.1 Valley Incision Baseline using accepted geo/surface-height-m and geo/valley-influence semantics.
